_note: The village loudspeaker. files are relative to assets/ and baked by scripts/make_rozhlas.py (song, muffled announcement, clear OPAKUJEM, announcement again); the game stays silent until they exist. One broadcast every period_s seconds at a clock-derived moment, the same on every client. It is one shared recording, not one per speaker: the level depends only on the distance to the nearest speaker (full level within reference_distance, rolloff_db quieter per doubling beyond it, silent past max_distance) and its low-pass falls from near_cutoff_hz to far_cutoff_hz over the same range (duller with distance).
